home.journeyTitle: A journey into the heart of Fez craftsmanship
home.journeyText: Tanning leather, laying zellige tile by tile, tracing calligraphy with a feather quill: these are the gestures passed down through generations of artisans that inspire every piece we make. Fezbariz was born from this attachment to a living craft, between Fez and Paris.

home.storyTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.storyText: Every piece is handmade by Moroccan artisans using traditional techniques: embroidery, weaving and time-honoured finishing. By choosing Fezbariz, you directly support these artisans and help keep a unique heritage alive.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Fezbariz, the house of elegance between Fez and Paris, was born from a passion for Moroccan textile craftsmanship and a desire to share it beyond borders.
about.missionText: We work directly with artisans and cooperatives in Morocco to offer authentic pieces, handmade following traditional methods, while ensuring fair compensation.
about.qualityText: Every gandoura, jellaba, caftan and children's jabador is made with care using artisanal techniques passed down through generations.
about.craftText: In Fez, leather tanning, zellige tiling and calligraphy are still passed down from master to apprentice. It's this same artisanal rigor we look for in every embroidery, every finish of our gandouras, jellabas, caftans and jabadors.
